brief:
Middle East Eye reports that Gaza is experiencing severe flooding described as a deliberate catastrophe, with Israel and Western governments avoiding accountability. The outlet's analysis suggests that those responsible face minimal consequences for the situation unfolding in the territory.

The reporting indicates a pattern of impunity, with international backing enabling continued policies despite the humanitarian toll on Gaza's civilian population.
dek: Gaza flooding is a catastrophe by design - and the spineless West is complicit Submitted by David Hearst on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 19:01 Israel and its backers are right to keep calm and carry on, because they are a long way from facing any real accountability…
title: Gaza faces flooding crisis amid accountability gap
